title: Design System: Brent & Denise — Retiring Abroad

display.purpose: Page and post titles only; capped at 36px.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Reserved. No component uses it; the system is flat.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.purpose: Hover, border, and color changes on controls and links.

motion.name: theme-transition
motion.purpose: Body text and background when the theme flips.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The main action on a view: subscribe, submit, visit.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: var(--color-accent); color: var(--color-surface); border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The lower-commitment action beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; padding: 8px 24px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-accent); border: 1px solid var(--color-accent); border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { opacity: 0.85; }

components.name: Tag Filter
components.description: Filter chip on the blog list; selected state marks the active tag.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 16px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-text-secondary); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; font-size: var(--text-sm); font-family: var(--font-body); cursor: pointer; transition: color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-tag[data-active="true"], .ds-tag:hover { color: var(--color-text); border-color: var(--color-accent); background-color: var(--color-surface); } .ds-tag-count { margin-left: 4px; font-size: var(--text-xs); color: var(--color-text-secondary); } .ds-tag[data-active="true"] .ds-tag-count { color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Post Card
components.description: The listing unit for a post: 16:9 image, serif title, date, excerpt, read-more link.
components.html:
How Much Does It Really Cost to Live Abroad?

August 20, 2026

We ran the numbers on rent, groceries, utilities, healthcare and dining out.

Read More
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--color-surface); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; overflow: hidden; } .ds-card-img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 9; object-fit: cover; display: block; } .ds-card-body { padding: 16px; } .ds-card-title { font-family: var(--font-heading); font-size: var(--text-lg); color: var(--color-text); margin: 0 0 8px; } .ds-card-date { display: block; font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin-bottom: 8px; } .ds-card-excerpt { font-size: var(--text-sm); color: var(--color-text-secondary); margin: 0 0 12px; } .ds-card-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-accent); }

components.name: Text Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; } .ds-field-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 4px; font-size: var(--text-sm); font-weight: 600; color: var(--color-text); } .ds-input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 12px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-text); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 4px; font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: var(--text-base); } .ds-input:focus { border-color: var(--color-accent); outline: none; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Header nav with the current page indicated by surface fill, plus the theme toggle.
components.html: BlogAbout
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 4px; } .ds-nav-link { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 4px 12px; border-radius: 4px; color: var(--color-text-secondary); font-size: var(--text-sm); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease, background-color 150ms ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link[aria-current="page"] { color: var(--color-text); background-color: var(--color-surface); }

narrative.overview: The site reads like a letter written from a warmer place: clay-toned paper, ink-brown prose, and serif headings that carry a human voice. It is a reading surface first. Every screen exists so a visitor can follow one couple's move abroad, so ornament stays out of the way of the sentences. Warmth comes from the palette and the serif, not from decoration. Surfaces are flat and separated by hairlines. There are no gradients, shadows in active use, or illustrated scenes. The terracotta accent is the only saturated color on the page, and it marks what can be acted on.
keyCharacteristics: Clay paper ground, ink umber text, one terracotta accent.
Georgia for headings, the platform sans for body and labels.
Flat surfaces with 1px alpha borders; no shadows in practice.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Terracotta covers under 10 percent of any screen. If a second element wants it, that element wants an underline, a border, or weight instead.

rules.name: The Contrast Floor Rule
rules.body: Body and meta text clear 4.5:1, and so does light text on accent fills. Test the accent as link text on the page background before using it as a background.

rules.name: The Voice Is Serif Rule
rules.body: Headings and the site name are serif. Everything that behaves like a control or a caption is sans. Do not set a button in Georgia.

dos: Do keep the accent under 10 percent of the viewport and use it to mark action.
Do verify any new text color against its actual background, including dark mode.
Do keep interactive targets at 44px minimum, including wrapped chips.
Do use the 4px spacing scale and the existing 64px section rhythm.
donts: Don't add shadows, gradients, glass, or glow effects.
Don't set controls or captions in Georgia.
Don't use dashed borders except for deliberate placeholders.
Don't exceed two columns for cards or raise display type above 36px.
Don't introduce a second accent color.
